items.headline: Connelly: Week 5 brought clarity, confusion to conference races
items.description: While Alabama muddied the SEC waters, the ACC picture got clearer -- or did it?

items.headline: No. 25 Pittsburgh takes on North Carolina in ACC action
items.description: North Carolina (2-2) at No. 25 Pittsburgh (5-0), Oct. 10 at 12 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Missouri jumps to 14th in AP Top 25; Florida tumbles 8 spots
items.description: Missouri jumped to No. 14 in the AP Top 25 following its rout of Florida, while the Gators dropped eight spots to No. 16 and were replaced by LSU in the top 10.

items.headline: Alabama's jab at Mississippi State tops trolls from Week 5 college football
items.description: Alabama took to social media to needle its Starkville hosts, writing "Not enough cowbells" in reference to Davis Wade Stadium's famous noise-making tradition.

items.headline: Pitt QB Mason Heintschel out for season with torn ACL
items.description: Pitt quarterback Mason Heintschel, one of the top young quarterbacks in college football, will miss the remainder of the season with a torn ACL, the team said.

items.headline: Pitt loses QB Heintschel to injury but outlasts Virginia Tech
items.description: As his Panthers improved to 5-0 with a 35-33 victory over Virginia Tech, Pittsburgh coach Pat Narduzzi lobbied for his unranked team, sending a message to AP Top 25 voters that he has "a hell of a football team."
